The '''invasion of Kheedar''' was carried out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a reprisal against attacks made by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. As it was occurring, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Noval Garaint]] was approaching [[Kheedar]] and used the confusion to infiltrate the [[Kheedar Ring/Legends|Kheedar Ring]] and gain control of its criminal empire.<ref name="GG9" />
